# Business Insider

> > Business Insider delivers global business news, financial markets data, and advertising solutions including branded content through Insider Studios.

Business Insider is a leading digital media company covering business, technology, finance, and markets worldwide. The platform offers comprehensive advertising solutions including programmatic, native, and video advertising, alongside regional editions like Business Insider Africa and real-time market data through Markets Insider.

## Key Topics

- Business Insider
- Insider Studios
- Branded content
- Custom content
- Advertising solutions
- Media advertising
- Programmatic advertising
- Video advertising
- Audience targeting
- First-party data
- Native advertising
- Content creation
- Markets data
- Social media marketing
- Case studies

## Advertising & Media Solutions

- [Business Insider Advertising](https://advertising.businessinsider.com/): Business Insider's advertising solutions hub for media & programmatic ads
- [Create | Business Insider Advertising](https://advertising.businessinsider.com/create): Insider Studios branded content creation services with client case studies
- [Connect | Business Insider Advertising](https://advertising.businessinsider.com/connect): Advertising sales team contacts and leadership directory

## Regional Editions

- [Business Insider Africa](https://africa.businessinsider.com/): Regional news site covering African business, markets, and leadership

## Markets & Financial Data

- [US Dollar Index | Global Market Indices | International Markets | Markets Insider](https://markets.businessinsider.com/index/us-dollar-index): US Dollar Index (DXY) data with historical prices and market snapshots

## Optional

- [Top Coupons for March 2026 | Insider](https://coupons.businessinsider.com/topcoupons): Curated discount codes for retailers like Amazon, adidas, and ASOS
